data.name: Jasim
data.gender_notes: Jasim is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jasim is a name derived from the Arabic word 'jasim' which means strong, powerful and healthy. The name Jasim carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jasim usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Jasim is frequently mentioned in Hadiths, where it signifies a person with a strong character and a determined spirit.
data.etymology: Jasim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jasim total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: جاسم
in_arabic.meaning: جاسم يعني الشخص القوي والشجاع والصلب
in_arabic.long_meaning: جاسم هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص القوي والشجاع والصلب، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس، الآية 18، حيث قال الله تعالى: 'وَلِتُكْرِمَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ'، وقد ذكر بعض المفسرين أن جاسم هو من أسماء الأقوياء في الجنة.

in_urdu.name: جاسم
in_urdu.meaning: جاسم کا مطلب ہے مضبوط، شجاع اور پکا
in_urdu.long_meaning: جاسم ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط، شجاع اور پکا۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا اہم مقام ہے۔ جاسم نام کے حامل افراد کو شجاعت، طاقت اور صبر کی صفات سے نوازا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जासिम
in_hindi.meaning: जासिम का अर्थ है मजबूत, बहादुर और दृढ़
in_hindi.long_meaning: जासिम एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत, बहादुर और दृढ़। यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लेखित है और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है। जासिम नाम वाले व्यक्तियों को बहादुरी, शक्ति और धैर्य के गुणों से नवाजा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: جاسم
in_pashto.meaning: جاسم د قوي، زړور او کلک سړي مطلب
in_pashto.long_meaning: جاسم د عربي اصل نوم دی چې د قوي، زړور او کلک سړي مطلب دی. دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې يادونه شوی دی او د افغانانو په کلتور کې يې مهم ځای لري. جاسم نوم لرونکي کسان د زړورتيا، طاقت او صبر د صفتونو سره مفتخر دي.

in_english.name: Jasim
in_english.long_meaning: Jasim is an Arabic name derived from the root 'J-S-M', which means strong, brave and robust. It is mentioned in the Quran and holds significance in Islamic tradition. The name Jasim is associated with qualities like courage, strength, and perseverance, making it a popular choice among Muslim parents.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jasim holds a powerful and positive meaning in Islamic culture. It is often given to baby boys who are expected to grow up to be strong, independent, and healthy individuals. This name holds a lot of significance as strength and good health are essential qualities that Muslims strive for, not only for personal growth but also for their communities and society as a whole.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Jasim takes on an additional significance. It reminds us of the strength and power of Allah (God) and how we, as Muslims, should strive to live our lives in accordance with His will. The name Jasim serves as a daily reminder of our spiritual responsibility to be strong in our faith, resilient in the face of adversity, and to continuously seek Allah's guidance and support. By embracing the meaning of this name, one can find the inner strength to overcome personal challenges and to contribute positively to the world around them.
